	construction_time = construction_time_6_months

        OR = {

		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes

			county.faith.religion = religion:hinduism_religion
			county.faith.religion = religion:buddhism_religion
			county.faith.religion = religion:jainism_religion
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }

        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		OR = {
